verdict.rationale: Appwrite's self-hosting docs explicitly promise "Full control over data location". You can run it on any Docker host or your own Kubernetes cluster via the official Helm chart, and one-click migration moves data between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted. So residency control is a first-party capability, but only by running your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: region selection on managed Appwrite Cloud, documented residency or data-location guarantees for the hosted service, and independent corroboration of residency control.
